aspect_delineations.delineation: A demanding configuration that is not negative in itself but rich in promise when mastered.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Illustrated by Steven Seagal, Céline Dion, Kevin Hart, and Louis de Funès.

aspect_delineations.delineation: A delicate dynamic plays out between reason and imagination, between logic and feeling. Mercury seeks precision, coherence, and clarity.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Illustrated by Iggy Pop, Simone de Beauvoir, and Yoko Ono.

aspect_delineations.delineation: This alliance produces a rare blend of enthusiasm and realism, as well as a special ability to adapt.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Illustrated by James Stewart, Marlene Dietrich, Donna Summer, and Whitney Houston.

aspect_delineations.delineation: Individuals often possess a kind of inner talisman until a challenge or a deep need reveals it.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Illustrated by Émile Zola, Halsey, Martin Luther King Jr., and SZA.

aspect_delineations.delineation: Listed as an article topic, but specific delineation details are not provided in the source context.
Sets in motion two planets pursuing seemingly opposite goals, yet ultimately complementary when it comes to the life path.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Illustrated by Adriana Lima.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Intellectual - Communicative - Objective
aspect_delineations.source_context: Basic pair description.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Happy - Philosophic
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to relationship concerns and fulfillment.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Stable - Disciplined
aspect_delineations.source_context: Difficult concerns in relationship, working through inhibitions and separations; necessitates growth and maturity.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Uniquely progressive or independent. The relationship needs must allow space to grow, change, and evolve individual expression.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Autocratic - Eccentric - Obstinate]. [Otherwise, you'll feel an urge to break away from it after a while].
aspect_delineations.source_context: One of the most independent and self-assertive combinations placed in the midpoint of relationship fulfillment.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Sensitive - Intuitive. May suggest bewildering experiences in relationships.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Vague - Undependable - Emotionally confused]. Can expect misunderstandings galore; even deception (or being deceived); certainly much discontent.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to relationship confusion and idealism.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Intense but well balanced. Ability to completely transform through feeling one with life purpose. Strong urge to transform and illuminate those held dear.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Fanatic - Extremist - Violent]. [Can be hard on close ones if they refuse to change].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to power struggles and identity transformation.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: The mind will be busy planning within concerns for relationships. Capitalizes on fulfillment, achievement, and popularity.
aspect_delineations.source_context: The native will think about and communicate about the combined energies.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Energies work in strong fashion to support or upset relationships for a dominant ego-expression. There will surely be a self-promoting drive to success.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [If this is not clear in the personality, then there are depressive mitigating circumstances that must be studied].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to assertion and relationships.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Central to healing the self. One fixes and heals oneself through understanding the active and passive sides of one's nature. Helps one develop as a wise teacher and healer. May embody the principle that no-one is perfect.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to self-healing through integrating ego and emotional sides.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Ego is illuminated through extreme passion, aggression, and force. A passionate attack to achieve an objective.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Intervention of some undeniable force or authority; upset of plans that is unredeemable].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to personal power and heroic assertion.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Expansion, recognition, and rewards can be accomplished through an innovative, eccentric approach to life purpose. By bringing attention to one's individuality or eccentricity.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to innovative achievement.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Good organizational skills. Ability to intuitively sense the structure and overall plan. Can devise reasonable strategies for achieving realistic goals. Successful in business or as an administrator. Takes into account drawbacks and tries to work around them.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to disciplined, successful planning.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Personal determination to not avoid methods, procedures, or ideas which are important. The faith brought to dreams and visions of the future. Adds to the ability to plan and visualize future paths of action.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Ego identifies with idealism/vision.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Energy helps people to become more aware of subtleties and bring their intuitions to light. Others come to an awareness of the deeper and hidden meanings in their existence, which heals them.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Healing through heightened intuitive awareness.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Sudden or unexpected intuitive awareness. To have unique insights into the subtleties of meaning within phenomena and into the nature of realms beyond the physical plane.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [An upset due to one’s psychic sensitivity].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to unique spiritual/psychic insight.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Unrelenting psychic sensitivity whose purpose is to bring transformation into one’s life. One feels intensely the importance of all the hidden energies at work in life.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Obsessiveness which may have a weakening effect on one’s vitality].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to intense transformative idealism.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A desire to be self-sacrificing to help the world. One’s life’s work involves using one’s psychic sensitivity and/or imagination. Pursuing one’s career with intuitive self-confidence.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to career and mission involving sensitivity/idealism.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Ego identified with idealism or confusion.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to personal style and projection.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Empowerment, a new perspective and transformation (PL) can be accomplished through beautiful, harmonious, and balanced communication (ME/VE).
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to transformative communication and persuasion.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: The ability to appreciate how communication happens in many different ways. Peace and calmness creates an atmosphere in which healing communication can happen. Helping, healing, or teaching others through beautiful thoughts; pursuit of aesthetic ideals in order to heal.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to healing through aesthetic and harmonious communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A genius for beautiful, artful and/or persuasive communication. Ability to catch others off guard when communicating. Having one’s own unique way of beautifully saying things.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to original, inventive communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: The ability to be very subtle when communicating. Fantasies and imaginings that are communicated beautifully.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [To delude oneself with superficial, lazy, and/or selfish thinking].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to subtle, imaginative communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Shrewd and insightful. Ability to always be clever and resourceful when any challenge comes up.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Sometimes become impatient and belligerent with others if their ideas seem poorly constructed]. [Sometimes not open to other points of view].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to aggressive, resourceful thought.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: To be guided spiritually when arguing, and because of this to use the conflict of ideas as a healing device. To say pointed things of a healing nature which carry a potent impact.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to arguments that lead to healing.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A genius for understanding and working with the conflict between ideas. An original, surprising, or unique way of arguing/putting ideas together.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to inventive, intellectual conflict.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Expresses one’s idealism with forcefulness. A subtle and/or covert aggressiveness when speaking.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Arguing in a vague or unformed manner that confuses other people].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to forceful idealism or confusing aggression.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A love of talking about a wide range of topics. Attracted to anything which expands and enriches the mind.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to loving expansive communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Action based on having taking a lot of factors into account. The willingness to modify one’s approach when what one is currently doing is inefficient or not working.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to actions based on extensive review.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Philosophical thinking of great depth. Learning that proceeds in a slow or gradual manner.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [One is burdened with too many ideas, making decisions difficult]. [Being uncertain as to how to put ideas together].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to philosophical or structured learning.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A love of unusual ideas. An ability to put ideas together in one’s own unique way. A strange, unusual, or highly distinctive philosophy of life. Creative and inventive mind; very progressive and forward-looking.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to innovative or unusual philosophy.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A clever and expansive imagination. One’s idealism causes one to reach out to a wealth of ideas.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to idealistic or imaginative thought.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Often denotes a professional writer. One has great influence over the ideals of others as well as having the ability to expand the consciousness of others through communications on a very conscious level. Potential for writing skills, being published, a novelist, public speaker, orator, or just having the gift of gab.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to expansive career/public communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: An enthusiasm which takes into account the drawbacks of any situation and tries to work around them. Success in organizing thoughts. Taking a good attitude toward difficult work.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to success in organizing and tackling difficult work.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Very good at detailed work and can excel as a specialist. Excellent mental concentration. Empowerment being undermined by depressed thought.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Can point to deep-seated fears such as 'Contemplating loss; fearing wipe-out; fearing abandonment']. [Sometimes miss general principles and concepts due to intense focus].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to specialized concentration and deep fear complexes.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: A genius for organizing ideas in an original and/or unique manner. The desire to overcome communication difficulties.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Negative thoughts about how one is different from other people, and a need to overcome those].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to inventive, structured communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: The native is a deep thinker inclined to approach scientific and complex studies. Life dedicated to the study, support from elderly people.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to dedication to complex, shared intellectual pursuits.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Orienting your life toward the upgrade of mechanical, electrical, or information processes. Added determination to use all resources to improve existing methods. Implementing rapid means for modernizing older techniques.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to life purpose tied to innovation and modernization.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Creative and inventive mind; very progressive and forward-looking. Works best in an environment that gives lots of room to explore and be creative. Ability to visualize new solutions inclines one to be optimistic and successful.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to optimistic, creative innovation.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Imaginative writing and ideas. Inspirational insight into religion and eternity and the ability to put it into words. Accepting words of reform and change. Seductive words.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to insightful or seductive communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Success through putting the imaginative and inspirational into words. Spiritual oratory. Compassionate judgments. Enchanting way with words.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to successful imaginative or spiritual communication.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Concise and disciplined inspirational writing or speech.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [More likely: obstacles to spiritual thinking and difficulties expressing spiritual thoughts]. [The repression of spiritual and unifying ideas or simply the lack of same].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to structured idealism or repressed spirituality.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Life purpose or ego definition (◉) can be accomplished through thoughts, ideas, and communication (ME) about profound, deep concepts (PL) and probing (PL) of the mental process (ME).
aspect_delineations.source_context: Sigmund Freud example; relates to identity through profound mental probing.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Subversive thoughts and obsessions. Tend to act in secret.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Data falsification, deception and concealment of information, the danger of being drawn into criminal networks].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to secretive, obsessive thoughts.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: To perceive subtle connections between ideas. To feel a spiritual obligation to share one’s ideas with others.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to sharing subtle, spiritual ideas with groups.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: One is strongly impacted by sharing ideas with others, and such experiences can be transforming in the extreme.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [One may put ideas together in a way that holds one back, and needs to “rewire” them].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to transformative impact from sharing ideas.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: N/A

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Quality of one's career involves communicating in a structured and disciplined way.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [One's point of view comes under scrutiny by authority].
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to disciplined, career-focused communication (Sir Winston Churchill example).

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Efficient thoughts and communication (ME) are accomplished through passion and sex (VE/MA). Excellent aptitude for understanding the arts, and talented in artistic areas. Talent for psychology; potential for a marriage counselor.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to communication focused on passion/aesthetics.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Efficient thoughts (ME) can be accomplished through overcoming (JU) limitations (SA), by experiencing extreme ups and downs. Career of mental judgment. Logical thought; philosophical thinking.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to mental judgment and philosophical success despite limits.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: N/A

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Efficient use of energy (MA) can be accomplished through self (ASC) discipline (SA) and self (ASC) restraint (SA).

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Potential to gain stability and structure (SA) through imagination and visions (NE) and dramatic outcomes (PL).
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to structural success via vision/transformation.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Highlights groundbreaking innovations (UR) for dealing with unconscious (NE) and psychoanalytical (PL) issues.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to innovative psychological/spiritual breakthroughs (Carl Jung example).

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: N/A

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Empowerment, a new perspective, and transformation (PL) can be accomplished through beautiful, harmonious, and balanced communication (ME/VE).
aspect_delineations.source_context: Elvis Presley example.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Energy, courage, boldness, passion, outburst, impatience, impulsiveness, rebellion, disobedience, promptitude, excitement, emotionality, effort, ambition, accidents.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to impulsive emotional energy.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Beauty, grace, charm, feeling, love, sensuality, enjoyment, luxury, comfort.
aspect_delineations.source_context: Relates to emotional needs satisfied by aesthetic/loving environments.

aspect_delineations.effective_manifestation: Sensibility, receptivity, impressionability, creativity.
aspect_delineations.ineffective_manifestation: [Be fooled, deception, irrealism, influence ability, duplicity].
